headline.en: Give each agent project a spending boundary
headline.zh: 为每个 Agent 项目设定支出边界

sub.en: AgentFuse wraps a command with a local API proxy, checks its configured budget before forwarding requests, and records usage in a local ledger. Inspect the price table before relying on the cost estimate.
sub.zh: AgentFuse 启动命令时插入本地 API 代理，在转发请求前检查预算，并把用量写入本地账本。先核对模型价格，再使用费用估算设置项目上限。

body.en: Choose a cumulative project cap or a window that resets at local midnight.
body.zh: 可使用项目累计上限，或按本地午夜重置的每日窗口。

body.en: Read bundled prices, overrides, unknown-model fallbacks and overlay drift without making a provider call.
body.zh: 无需调用服务商即可查看内置价格、覆盖值、未知模型回退和价格差异。

body.en: bbolt stores request counts, token usage and configured dollar costs for status reporting.
body.zh: bbolt 保存请求数、Token 用量和按配置计算的费用，供 status 查询。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The supplied Go example runs the production bundled-price resolver for gpt-4o and an unlisted model. Token counts are explicit example inputs, not a live response.
note.zh: 随仓 Go 示例使用实际价格解析器查询 gpt-4o 与未收录模型。Token 数量是明确给定的示例输入，不来自在线响应。

body.en: The supplied Go example runs the production bundled-price resolver for gpt-4o and an unlisted model. Token counts are explicit example inputs, not a live response.
body.zh: 随仓 Go 示例使用实际价格解析器查询 gpt-4o 与未收录模型。Token 数量是明确给定的示例输入，不来自在线响应。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/agentfuse.git
cd agentfuse
go build -o bin/fuse ./cmd/fuse

limitations.en: Budget decisions depend on configured rates, estimated output and supported usage parsing; they do not guarantee the final provider bill.
limitations.zh: 预算决策依赖配置价格、输出估算和支持的用量解析，不能保证服务商最终账单金额。

limitations.en: The recorded example exercises price resolution only; it does not test live proxy traffic or account credentials.
limitations.zh: 记录的示例仅运行价格解析，没有验证在线代理流量或账户凭据。

limitations.en: Calls that bypass the proxy are outside its ledger and budget.
limitations.zh: 绕过代理的调用不在账本和预算管理范围内。

body.en: An autonomous coding session can make many API calls before you inspect the bill. A project budget makes the next request an explicit decision: the proxy reserves estimated cost, forwards accepted calls and reconciles the returned usage.
body.zh: 自动运行的编程会话可能在查看账单前就发出大量 API 请求。项目预算把下一次请求变成明确决策：代理预留估算费用，转发获准请求，再依据响应中的用量结算。

body.en: The launcher rewrites provider base URLs for its child. The proxy applies account checks and reserves budget in the bbolt ledger, then sends accepted requests through the provider handler. Usage from the response reconciles the reservation; local token estimation covers supported missing-usage cases. The price resolver owns model-prefix lookup and override precedence.
body.zh: 启动器为子命令改写服务商基础 URL。代理检查账户并在 bbolt 账本中预留预算，再通过对应协议处理器转发请求。返回用量用于结算预留费用；支持的用量缺失场景由本地 Token 估算补充。价格解析器统一处理模型前缀匹配和覆盖优先级。

title.en: A request gate around the child command
title.zh: 围绕子命令的请求检查

body.en: The launcher rewrites provider base URLs for its child. The proxy applies account checks and reserves budget in the bbolt ledger, then sends accepted requests through the provider handler. Usage from the response reconciles the reservation; local token estimation covers supported missing-usage cases. The price resolver owns model-prefix lookup and override precedence.
body.zh: 启动器为子命令改写服务商基础 URL。代理检查账户并在 bbolt 账本中预留预算，再通过对应协议处理器转发请求。返回用量用于结算预留费用；支持的用量缺失场景由本地 Token 估算补充。价格解析器统一处理模型前缀匹配和覆盖优先级。

alt.en: A request gate around the child command
alt.zh: 围绕子命令的请求检查

body.en: The provider handlers translate request and response shapes; your selected client must honor the base URL configured by the launcher. AgentFuse accounts for traffic that passes through its proxy. The local price table is separate from the provider invoice.
body.zh: 服务商处理器适配请求和响应格式；所选客户端须遵循启动器设置的基础 URL。AgentFuse 统计经过其代理的流量。本地价格表与服务商最终账单是两个不同依据。

body.en: The nearest .fuse.toml owns cap_usd, window (project/daily), account, provider and optional upstream_url. openai_compat requires an upstream URL. ~/.fuse/accounts.toml holds named account credentials; ~/.fuse/prices.toml overrides model rates; ~/.fuse/ledger.db holds usage. The bundled price snapshot is historical and never updates itself from the network.
body.zh: 最近的 .fuse.toml 定义 cap_usd、window（project/daily）、account、provider 和可选 upstream_url。openai_compat 必须填写上游 URL。~/.fuse/accounts.toml 保存命名账户凭据，~/.fuse/prices.toml 覆盖模型价格，~/.fuse/ledger.db 保存用量。内置价格是历史快照，不会自行联网更新。

body.en: After building, add this repository’s bin directory to PATH or use the binary’s full path. In a chosen project, init creates .fuse.toml; cap changes its limit; status reads the ledger. For a configured API client, fuse run <command> starts the proxy and exits with the child. A named account requires its matching account configuration.
body.zh: 构建后将本仓库 bin 目录加入 PATH，或使用二进制完整路径。在目标项目中，init 创建 .fuse.toml，cap 修改上限，status 查询账本。配置好 API 客户端后，fuse run <command> 启动代理并跟随子进程退出。命名账户需要对应的账户配置。

details.code:
cd /path/to/your/project
fuse init --cap 5
fuse prices --check openai/gpt-4o --diff
fuse status
fuse cap +5

changelog.zh: 修复 Responses API 请求侧的输入兜底：此前 /v1/responses 请求的输入文本从未被提取（只解析 Chat Completions 的 messages/prompt 字段），截断的流式响应会把输入侧按 0 个 token 计费（fail-open）；现在 instructions 与 input（字符串或消息数组）都会进入 tiktoken 估算。同时解析 max_completion_tokens，让预检预留采用客户端声明的输出上限；修复 demo 工作流自 v0.4.0 起在每个标签上因 detached HEAD push 失败的问题；版本联动测试补上 CHANGELOG 面。
changelog.en: Fixes the Responses-API request-side input fallback: /v1/responses request text was never extracted (only Chat Completions messages/prompt were parsed), so a truncated streamed response billed the input side as 0 tokens (fail-open); instructions and input (string or message array) now feed the tiktoken estimate. Also parses max_completion_tokens so the pre-flight reserve honors the client's declared output ceiling, fixes the demo workflow that failed on every tag since v0.4.0 (detached-HEAD push), and extends the version lockstep test to the CHANGELOG surface.

changelog.zh: fuse --version 现在如实报告所发布标签的版本（v0.12.0 发布只改了处理器代码，VERSION、main.go 版本号与 CHANGELOG 全部滞留为 0.11.0，站点内容版本还停在更早的值）；同时补齐 OpenAI Responses API 单次返回里推理摘要文本的捕获，让准确度采样器在 o3/gpt-5 单次请求上测到诚实的估值。
changelog.en: fuse --version now reports the shipped tag honestly (the v0.12.0 release changed only the handler code, leaving VERSION, the main.go version literal, and the CHANGELOG stale at 0.11.0, and the site content version lagging even further); the OpenAI Responses-API unary reasoning-summary text is now captured too, so the accuracy harness measures an honest estimate on unary o3/gpt-5 traffic.

changelog.zh: 扩展思考流现在也被计入：Anthropic thinking_delta 的推理文本会累计进流式用量估算，截断的思考模型流不再只按可见文本少计输出侧、从而突破上限（fail-open 修复）。
changelog.en: Extended-thinking streams are now counted: Anthropic thinking_delta reasoning text is accumulated into the streaming usage estimate, so a truncated thinking-model stream no longer bills only the visible text and lets spend exceed the cap (fail-open fix).

changelog.zh: 按侧 tiktoken 兜底现在也作用于 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 处理器，部分用量流不再会少计输出侧而让花费突破预算上限。托管账户密钥现在也会注入到 Gemini provider。
changelog.en: The per-side tiktoken fallback now applies to the Anthropic and OpenAI handlers too, so a partial-usage stream can no longer under-bill the output side and let spend exceed the cap. The managed account key is now injected for the Gemini provider.
